g90qhy:225: The release of Claude Design marks an important turning point: design tools are shifting from the model of "humans operating on the canvas, AI assisting to accelerate" to "AI is the primary generator, humans are the primary reviewers." This is a paradigm shift from "human-led creative execution" to "AI-led creative generation." The core significance of this shift is that the designer's role changes from "hands-on making" to "eyes-on reviewing." Ryan Mather alone can oversee Anthropic's seven product lines because AI takes on the execution work; humans only need to make decisions and review. This is not an efficiency improvement, but a restructuring of the productivity model.
